historical_commentary.text: This note optimizes fuzzy string matching (edit distance and LCS algorithms) in the FuzzyTools component by pre-filtering candidate records using indexed string-length fields before running expensive sequential comparisons. The specific FuzzyTools component and its 4D 2004-era command syntax (Fuzzy_FindByEditDistanceCount, Fuzzy_FindByLCSLength) are tied to classic procedural 4D code predating 4D v11's native SQL engine and predating ORDA, but the core algorithmic insight — using string length as an indexed pre-filter to bound edit-distance/LCS search space before sequential comparison — is a timeless optimization technique still valid in any fuzzy-matching implementation today. Modern 4D developers would more likely reach for full-text search indexes or external fuzzy-matching libraries/services rather than a custom component like this.
